newsitem.title: CHINA: Road King invests in Hebei highway.
newsitem.headline: Road King invests in Hebei highway.

text.p: Road King Infrastructure Ltd said on Wednesday it had signed an agreement to invest in and operate Hanguan highway, which links Highway 309 Handan to Guantao highway in China's Hebei province.
Road King said the total project investment amounted to 400 million yuan, of which it would hold a 70 percent stake.
The 79-km Hanguan highway is a four-lane highway and has two toll stations which are already collecting tolls.
Road King said the highway project would be its second in Hebei province.
Of 24 toll road projects in seven Chinese provinces, 20 were in operation and generating contributions for the company, Road King said.
